target: new service-operated VPS 179.236.71.203 (4 vCPU, 15.6 GiB, 193 GB, Ubuntu 26.04.1, kernel 7.0.0-34); two invite-only accounts, one global running customer task
owner_authorization: owner said "go to next phase" then "do everything yourself"; owner approved migration to the new server earlier

host_changes.gvisor: runsc release-20261005.0 installed to /usr/local/bin (sha256 runsc 210b437a…, shim 2bff94d1…); registered as a second runtime on the owner engine (additive; /etc/docker/daemon.json backup kept)
host_changes.cell_engine: separate dockerd (agentai-cells-docker) on /run/agentai-cells/docker.sock, data-root /var/lib/agentai-cells/docker, default runtime runsc, own bridge agentai0 10.77.0.0/16, per-cell nets from 10.78.0.0/16, icc=false, no-new-privileges
host_changes.firewall: drop-only nftables table inet agentai_cells (cells cannot reach host services, private ranges, metadata or other cells; quarantined cells have all egress dropped)
host_changes.services: agentai-supervisor-native (root, caps limited, 768M cap) and agentai-lifecycle-worker (app user, no caps, 128M cap) enabled; zero enrolled bindings so nothing can dispatch
host_changes.incident: first cell-engine start collided with the owner engine bridge name docker0 and deleted it; docker0 was recreated as 172.17.0.1/16 and verified with a default-bridge container; owner stack never affected

findings: Fleet restore refuses another tenant slug and swaps the whole data dir, impossible on a volume mounted there; the host uses its own bounded extractor into a freshly created quarantine cell
fleet create accepts --gateway-token, so the host supplies the token from custody and never scrapes stdout
Fleet backup requires a stopped cell; Fleet places cell data in $HOME/.openclaw/fleet/cells/<tenant> and auth in auth-profile-secrets/<tenant>
Docker isolation alone left SSH/HTTPS on the host reachable from a cell; the nftables table closes it (verified by counters and probes)
Chromium needs a writable HOME and CHROME_HEADLESS under the read-only worker envelope; the fixed catalog command sets them
The supervisor now answers effect-free "account not enrolled" as busy so unenrolled operations wait instead of becoming uncertain

measurements.idle_gateway_cell_under_gvisor: container 756 MiB of 1 GiB cap; host available memory fell 458 MiB
measurements.browser_stage_light_page: Chromium loading example.com under gVisor peaked at 134 MiB container / 126 MiB host (light page only; heavy pages are bounded by the 1.5 GiB cap, not measured)
measurements.disk_cap: 300 MiB loop volume stopped a 400 MiB write at 200 MiB; cell and host stayed healthy

local_checks: 299 platform tests pass (2 Linux-only skips on macOS); new modules covered by test_netpolicy, test_volumes, test_secrets_custody, test_broker, test_sleep, test_maintenance, test_fleet_maintenance, test_native_wiring, test_worker, test_enroll_cli

Heavy-page and sustained-load peaks, simultaneous concurrency, restore-and-promote drill, power loss and reboot recovery are Phase 15
Reboot persistence of the new units was not tested (server not rebooted)
